investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Velworks News (news and media publishing); Platform: Google Cloud southamerica-east1 (zones southamerica-east1-a/southamerica-east1-b/southamerica-east1-c); network range 10.160.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster velwor-prod-southa (GKE); Database: postgres server media-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-media-to-db; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
